levels.title: Cache System Design Base
levels.summary: Start with ownership, recency, frequency, and strict operation budgets. These quests teach how multiple structures cooperate behind one small API.
invariants: Every live key has exactly one value and one order node
Eviction removes the globally correct victim
Capacity and empty-state edges never break the index

questions.title: LRU Cache
questions.goal: Make get and put average O(1) while keeping exact recency order.
questions.checkpoint: Can you move, insert, and evict a node without branching on head/tail?

questions.title: LFU Cache
questions.goal: Coordinate value lookup, frequency lookup, and recency inside each frequency.
questions.checkpoint: Can you update min-frequency correctly when a bucket becomes empty?

questions.title: Design In-Memory File System
questions.goal: Model folders and files behind path operations with deterministic listing.
questions.checkpoint: Is path parsing independent from traversal and node behavior?

questions.title: Design Compressed String Iterator
questions.goal: Expose a tiny iterator API without expanding the encoded input.
questions.checkpoint: Can one cursor represent the next output across multi-digit counts?

questions.title: Design Most Recently Used Queue
questions.goal: Fetch by rank, then move the chosen value to the most-recent end.
questions.checkpoint: Which structure makes both rank lookup and reorder affordable?

levels.title: Data Flow Processing Center
levels.summary: Process events as they arrive. Learn when monotonic time simplifies cleanup, how rolling aggregates avoid rescanning, and how to repair out-of-order records.
invariants: Expired events leave the active window exactly once

questions.title: Moving Average from Data Stream
questions.goal: Maintain a window statistic without recomputing the whole window.
questions.checkpoint: What exact event makes the oldest value expire?

questions.title: Logger Rate Limiter
questions.goal: Turn a timing rule into compact key-specific state.
questions.checkpoint: Can stale keys be cleaned without changing observable behavior?

questions.title: Design Hit Counter
questions.pattern: Time window queue or circular buckets
questions.goal: Count recent traffic while coalescing repeated timestamps.
questions.checkpoint: How does your design change when traffic per second is huge?

questions.title: Number of Recent Calls
questions.goal: Use ordered arrival time to make window cleanup amortized O(1).
questions.checkpoint: Can you prove each timestamp enters and leaves once?

questions.title: Stock Price Fluctuation
questions.pattern: Primary map + ordered multiset or lazy heaps
questions.goal: Support corrections, latest value, minimum, and maximum together.
questions.checkpoint: When data is corrected, how are stale extrema removed safely?

levels.title: Data Structure Design Workshop
levels.summary: Implement familiar abstractions instead of consuming them. The focus shifts to representation choices, collision policy, rebalancing, and probabilistic structure.
invariants: Public operations never expose internal sentinel state
Expected and worst-case costs are stated honestly

questions.title: Design Circular Queue
questions.goal: Represent FIFO state in fixed memory without shifting elements.
questions.checkpoint: Can you distinguish full from empty without ambiguous pointers?

questions.title: Design HashSet
questions.goal: Own the hash function, buckets, membership, and removal behavior.
questions.checkpoint: What input pattern produces your worst collision chain?

questions.title: Design HashMap
questions.goal: Extend membership into correct replacement and retrieval semantics.
questions.checkpoint: How do you distinguish a missing key from a stored sentinel-like value?

questions.title: Insert Delete GetRandom O(1)
questions.goal: Combine random access with constant-time deletion by swapping with the tail.
questions.checkpoint: Which index must be repaired after a removal swap?

questions.title: Design Skiplist
questions.goal: Build expected logarithmic search, add, and erase without a balanced tree library.
questions.checkpoint: Can one predecessor search path drive both insertion and deletion?

levels.title: Business System Simulation Platform
levels.summary: Translate business language into entities and legal state transitions. These quests reward clean domain keys, atomic updates, and explicit failure behavior.
invariants: Every command begins from a legal state
Summary queries derive from authoritative records

questions.title: Design Parking System
questions.goal: Encode a small allocation policy with correct rejection behavior.
questions.checkpoint: Does a failed admission mutate capacity?

questions.title: Design Underground System
questions.goal: Pair check-in/check-out events and maintain route averages incrementally.
questions.checkpoint: Which composite key uniquely names a directed route?

questions.title: Design Authentication Manager
questions.goal: Model generation, renewal, expiry, and live-count semantics.
questions.checkpoint: Is expiry inclusive or exclusive at the current timestamp?

questions.title: Simple Bank System
questions.goal: Keep account validation and balance mutation atomic across transfers.
questions.checkpoint: Can every rejected operation prove that no balance changed?

questions.title: Design an ATM Machine
questions.goal: Plan a withdrawal, validate it fully, then commit inventory changes.
questions.checkpoint: Why must mutation wait until the whole withdrawal succeeds?

levels.title: Comprehensive Data Operation Simulation Station
levels.summary: Finish with systems that combine ranking, editing, lookup, allocation, and lifecycle operations. Design the source of truth first, then make every secondary index agree.
invariants: Each entity has one authoritative lifecycle state
Every secondary index can be repaired from canonical data
A multi-step command commits all related index changes together

questions.title: Design Twitter
questions.goal: Combine follow relationships, append-only posts, and bounded recency queries.
questions.checkpoint: Can feed generation avoid sorting every historical post?

questions.title: Design a File Sharing System
questions.goal: Track membership, chunk ownership, joins, leaves, and ID reuse.
questions.checkpoint: Which indexes must be cleaned when a user leaves?

questions.title: Design Movie Rental System
questions.goal: Keep availability, rented state, price ordering, and top-five reports synchronized.
questions.checkpoint: Can rent/drop update every ordered index without stale entries?

questions.title: Design a Text Editor
questions.goal: Support insertion, deletion, and cursor movement without rebuilding all text.
questions.checkpoint: What representation makes cursor-local edits cheap?

questions.title: Design Spreadsheet
questions.goal: Separate cell addressing, sparse storage, reset behavior, and evaluation.
questions.checkpoint: Can the parser distinguish literals and cell references cleanly?

questions.title: All O`one Data Structure
questions.pattern: Count buckets + key index + linked order
questions.goal: Return any minimum/maximum key while every update remains O(1).
questions.checkpoint: Can empty count buckets disappear without breaking neighboring buckets?
